inherited.M01: Overt read/broadcast speech video with paired audio (LRW, LRS2, LRS3, VoxCeleb2, AVSpeech)
inherited.M03: LRW front-end pretraining, then supervised training on 818-3,448 h; 75 epochs, AdamW; no seeds or repeated runs (Ma et al. 2021/2022 lineage)
inherited.M04: Overt speech; audio, video or both at test
inherited.M05: Mouth-ROI video (96x96 per paper) and raw audio, 25 frames per second
inherited.M06: ResNet-18 + Conformer encoders per modality, MLP fusion, joint CTC/attention Transformer decoder (Ma et al. 2021 conformer AVSR lineage)
inherited.M07: Transformer LM for visual-only decoding only; no LM for ASR and AV-ASR
inherited.M11: Original LRS2/LRS3 transcripts and splits; no speaker-overlap statement

topics.inclusion_rule: Studies whose ledger text names lip reading, visual speech recognition (VSR), AVSR or audio-visual speech recognition, classified from the full text (reference list removed) by the training-label source for unlabelled video: transcripts produced by an audio ASR model or other automatic labeller (pseudo-labels), self-supervised pretraining, or cross-modal teacher distillation. Boundary: a study counts under every design its text names, mentions in related work included (upper bound); papers that only cite or reuse Auto-AVSR as a checkpoint or scorer stay in the population; video-to-speech synthesis is in the population only when its ledger names VSR or AVSR; versions counted once.
topics.pattern: (lip[- ]?read|lipread|visual speech recognition|\bVSR\b|\bAVSR\b|audio-visual speech recognition|audiovisual speech recognition)
topics.design_field: M03 supervision_kind (ledger) and full-text regexes asr_pseudo_labels, self_supervised_pretraining, cross_modal_distillation, human_or_caption_transcripts_only
topics.metric: LRS3 VSR and AV-ASR WER versus labelled and unlabelled hours

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: studies reporting visual-only WER on the LRS3 test set, any training regime; audio-only and audio-visual rows, LRS2/LRW/GRID-only results and quoted numbers excluded; versions once.
topics.metric: LRS3 VSR WER (%) with training hours and data access
